title: MORNING OAT
hook: MORNING OAT|breakfast that respects your time
style: bright natural daylight photography, white kitchen, soft window light, clean pale surfaces, airy, high key, shallow depth of field

music.tags: friendly corporate pop, ukulele, hand claps, light percussion, warm major key, optimistic, instrumental

beats.prompt: A white ceramic bowl of oats on a pale wooden counter, bright morning window light behind
beats.motion: Steam rises slowly. Light shifts across the rim.
beats.caption: Six a.m.

beats.prompt: Milk pouring into a bowl of oats in slow motion, splash frozen mid air, white kitchen
beats.motion: The pour lands and ripples outward.

beats.prompt: A handful of blueberries falling onto oats, bright daylight, shallow focus
beats.motion: Berries drop and settle into the surface.

beats.prompt: A hand lifting a spoon of oats, close, sunlight across the knuckles, white kitchen
beats.motion: The spoon lifts and turns slightly.

beats.prompt: A woman standing at a bright kitchen window holding a bowl, morning light, back to camera
beats.motion: She shifts her weight. Light moves on the glass.

beats.prompt: A pale cardboard packet standing on a white counter, soft daylight, clean label
beats.motion: Slow push in on the packet.
beats.caption: Oats, seeds, nothing else

beats.prompt: Rolled oats, pumpkin seeds and dried fruit arranged on white paper, overhead, bright
beats.motion: Slow overhead drift across the ingredients.

line.text: Oats, seeds, fruit. That is the whole list.

beats.prompt: A woman in a coat picking up a bag by a bright front door, morning light through glass
beats.motion: She turns toward the door and reaches.

line.text: You are already out the door.

beats.prompt: A pale cardboard packet of oats on a white counter in bright morning light, clean and simple
beats.caption: MORNING OAT
